answer: A trading desk opens only after a postal watch. The applicant pays 48 coins to rent one city box for 18 days and must receive a sealed blotter mailed by the epoch clerk, dyed in yarrow ink whose lot is published after the rent locks. The applicant photographs the blotter micro-number and posts a 12-second recording of a plucked thread; overtone peaks must sit inside a seed-published nebula of frequency bins, each within 3 Hz. Anyone can check the spectrogram and the clerk's mailed serial list. A reused blotter or a missed bin forfeits the rent, so every alias needs its own box and blotter.
